The '''Council of Elders''' was the governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Glee Anselm/Legends|Glee Anselm]]. It consisted of representatives from each of the planet's settlements. Each representative had the title of "elder," though they were not necessarily of advanced age.<ref name="FDCR" />
